strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
So the colony drop failed.
Heh... In a sense, the opposite of my Rafflesia Project:
a purge of Earth through sheer, overwhelming mass...
I had some hopes for it, but it seems I must act myself after all.
(Zabine reports the Gandor Team is quelling the chaos on the surface...
I never thought I'd have to hurry this much.)
All right, we're inside the Frontier colony! ...Hm, what's that!?
A big... flower mecha...?
Those guys... weren't they at that abandoned colony a while back...
Tch... No matter how you look at it, that's a villain's mecha.
Let's hurry up and take 'em out!
Don't decide friend or foe by mecha design...
It doesn't look like a pacifist's mecha, though.
True... and that's a formation set to intercept us.
Transmission from the large enemy mecha. Putting it through.
I've been waiting, Londo Bell...! Stopping the colony drop... splendid.
...Which is precisely why you must die here.
What? Out of nowhere, saying whatever you like!
Yes, just who do you think you are!?
...I am no one.
Just a man... who wears an iron mask to face his own weakness...!
Huh?
What...? This feeling. ...That guy...
...Wearing a mask to achieve something is hardly unusual.
But... that's irrelevant to us now.
If you get in our way, we'll beat you to a pulp!
Fools... Even children act on emotion alone, blind to good and evil.
Heh, so what's wrong with that!?
With humans still the emotional beasts of old, we're on the verge
of devouring the Earth Sphere! Why can't you see that!
Even so, vainly deciding on your own that you've evolved...
I just can't forgive people like that...!
...Captain, give the order to launch.
Captain...?
R-right. All units, launch!
Ideals and dreams... I won't complain about chasing them.
But if they can only be achieved by sacrificing others...
I'll stake my life to stop them!
How naive!
Naive, my foot! If it bugs you, try beating us!
That's what's great about Daisuke! Let's go!
All units, please launch!
Humans fighting humans... is this really the time!?
It seems it's ready in time. Oho... so this is it.
A Zaku head... but it's way bigger than the others!? A new model!?
So it seems. ...But where did they get Zeon technology?
True, it's not a type in the Neo Zeon forces...
but last time, too, they were running with this tasteless flower mecha.
Maybe people with bad taste just get along?
There was a similar type on the ground...
Though there, it was operating with the Zeon forces...
Lord Carozzo.
It's finally complete, I see. So that's the Apsaras III. ...Splendid.
It seems someone in Zeon understands what a mobile armor is.
...What kind of taste is that?
Looks like it's just as the Captain said...
Looks have little to do with power. I've got a bad feeling about this...
That mouth open in front, yeah.
Right. Stay sharp, everyone.
Moving to support the Rafflesia. ...Ah, yes, Iron Mask.
Back from the surface, are you? What is it, Zabine Chareux?
...I've taken the head of this Apsaras Project into custody.
Barely breathing, but should survive.
...Interesting. I'll meet with them later. Before that...
I hold no personal grudge against you... but this is my job.
Like a few reinforcements would scare me!
Judau, get 'em!
If size alone won battles, it'd be easy...!
Hell yeah! Let's do it... Hm, what!?
Two small mobile suits have entered the colony.
There it is...! It's here, Cecily!
That mobile armor... Iron Mask...!
That's... a Gundam!? And the other is a Crossbone mobile suit!
Another new Gundam... Anaheim's been busy... Or not?
...It seems it isn't an Anaheim make. It's quite small...
Wow, what's going on? Captain, any idea?
I'm hailing them. You two, who are you?
...This is Gundam F91, Seabook Arno!
We're not enemies! We followed that mobile armor here!
Mobile armor... you mean that giant flower?
...The brat from before...! Insolent!
Gundam... F91... A Formula Project unit!?
Never heard of it. You know it, Lieutenant Uraki?
Yeah. That's...
We can talk later! We have to stop Iron Mask!
That thing... that thing has to be completely destroyed here...!
Captain, I'm treating them as allies... All right?
F91... a SNRI mobile suit... All right, Seabook, was it?
Sorry, but please join the battle.
Understood.
Roger.
Lady Berah Ronah... If you side with those who cling to Earth...
I'll show no mercy...!
Zabine, you must know that you're the one
dancing to Iron Mask's delusions!
If, in the end, it benefits our Crossbone Vanguard...
...I'll do whatever it takes.
Tch, same goes for Zeon, but what's wrong with clinging to Earth!
It's where we were born, dammit!
Exactly! Any reform that can only be achieved
by abandoning your homeland doesn't amount to much.
Fools... There's no talking to you.
What's wrong with caring about your home!
Laugh if you want.
...But we'll protect our homeland to the end...!
What...! I see, so this force stopped Zeon's colony too...!
All riiight! Go down!
...Yamada! It can still move! Watch out!
Evasive action!? No! All units, cut off that mobile armor's escape!
It's going to run!
...If I'm to take on these people...
the Bugs need far more work to be of any use. I'll withdraw!
If it gets away now...!
Iron Mask!
Berah... you truly are a naughty child...
It isn't good to doubt what grown-ups do.
Wow, it can still move like that.
No time to be impressed! Bright, are we going after it?
...But it's already out of sight.
Is this the time to be impressed!?
But Tetsuya, it's already flown out of the colony!
Cecily... is it?
Yes... I'm Cecily Fairchild...
The pilot of that mobile armor... I'd guess an officer
of the Crossbone Vanguard, and you seem to know that person.
I'd like to hear about it later, if I may.
Cecily... are you sure? There's no turning back...
...Yes.
My, my, looks like another one with a story...
Phew. Fighting a huge thing like that
in a cramped place like this... gimme a break.
Yeah. But it looks like we managed to clear it out.
But... the mobile armor got away...
Can't track it. It's scattering Minovsky particles like crazy.
Omoikane's marker has come off, too.
Like that Zaku dumpling... it may use thrust tech
that isn't used anywhere else...
Can't help it if it ran. So, what now?
What else? We've gotta keep going.
The Gyandlar have been quiet lately,
but it seemed like they're up to something, y'know?
Maybe they realized they can't win by charging in without a plan...
Which would make them all the more troublesome.
...I agree. But things are settling down, both on Earth and in space...
If the invaders are going to strike, now's the only time.
I'm more concerned that with the moment here, the Meganoids and
the Bunker aren't moving. And there's the Jovian matter, too.
Yeah...
...I feel like this'll twist and turn a few more times.
It's hard to stick strictly to defense...
but with this many enemies, it can't be helped...
But... if we hold firm, sooner or later they'll slip up.
Yup! A straight man who's too harsh makes it hard to play the fool,
Izumi said so, too.
...Indeed.
That's an inappropriate analogy.
...Captain Bright, about Seabook and company...
That's right.
...Seabook, that suit was developed by the Federation's naval institute...
SNRI, correct?
Yes... My mother was involved in its development.
Seabook!? You don't have to tell them that much...
Cecily, now that we're this involved... we can't act like we don't know.
You get it. Well, we won't treat you badly.
Yep, yep.
Just leave it to us big sisters.
Women are strong... as they say.
Huh? Wasn't that a little sarcastic?
Still... with them being developed in so many places,
Nergal would like to develop a Gundam too.
Oh! When that happens, I'll be the pilot of Unit 1!
Ahem. ...Very well. I'm with Londo Bell, an independent Federation unit:
Bright Noa, captain of the Ra Cailum.
As you know... the Earth Sphere is in crisis,
and right now, there are far too few to defend it.
Iron Mask's plan... I just can't believe it's truly underway yet.
We'll fight too.
Cecily...
(Yes... I'll sever these blood ties with my own hands...)
